The Summary Page's stated total is 0. A real zero, looked at on the page.

itemized.page_subtotal_gates: p3 prints no subtotal figure (blank schedule; only the TOTAL cell carries the zero glyph). p4's SUBTOTAL FOR THIS PAGE cell was left BLANK by the filer, so the page-subtotal gate cannot fire there; the single row 1000.00 does equal the printed TOTAL EXPENDITURES MADE $1000.00 - gate fires at the schedule level.

itemized.notes: The 2012-vintage form heads its schedules 'Itemized Contributions Received' / 'Itemized Expenditures Made' rather than 'Schedule A' / 'Schedule B'; they are the same tables. FORM FACE vs FILENAME (already noted at the totals tranche and confirmed here): the file is named '..._12_Final_...' but only the Year-End box is checked. Page 3 carries a faint SHOW-THROUGH of handwriting from the reverse of the sheet (a ghost line across one empty row) - it is bleed-through, not an entry, and nothing was transcribed from it. The single expenditure's recipient text runs the full width of the Name of Recipient cell and slightly into the Purpose column; the columns are still unambiguous.
